source_assumptions: Candidate H-MICRO-2026-10-19 continues the frozen static S2 action to microscopic ordinary rest-mass sources and treats its quadratic response as a reciprocal pair interaction.
The electron and proton have standard inertial masses and a source operator sum_i m_i delta(x-x_i); self terms are removed. No expectation-density Schrodinger-Newton closure is assumed.
A quantum or adiabatically eliminable mediator and negligible noise/retardation are extra assumptions absent from the frozen theory.
Uniform proton mass radius R_m=sqrt(5/3) times the measured charge rms radius is an illustrative sensitivity model only. Charge radius does not measure gravitational mass radius.
Isotropic finite-background A examples are exact linear-response controls. The actual external Galactic response is anisotropic; its leading high-k coefficient is the same.
